title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-l9ck: fragment.rs from_bytes signature change broke integration tests
description:
The from_bytes signature was changed from `(data: &'a [u8]) -> Result<Self>` to `(data: &'a [u8], out: &'a mut [u8]) -> Result<Self>`. The implementation in fragment.rs and the FragmentReceiver caller were updated, but 6 call sites in two test files were not updated:

tests/fragmentation.rs:
- Line 110: `Fragment::from_bytes(&[0x78, 0x7c, 0])` — malformed input check
- Line 112: `Fragment::from_bytes(&regular_nonzero_padding)` — nonzero padding check
- Line 221: `Fragment::from_bytes(&wire[..length])` — sender round-trip

tests/fragmentation_vectors.rs:
- Line 210: `Fragment::from_bytes(&wire)` — round-trip check
- Line 236: `Fragment::from_bytes(&wire)` — retransmission test
- Line 373: `Fragment::from_bytes(&wire)` — invalid wire test

Result: `cargo test -p lichen-schc` fails with E0061 at all 6 locations.
